items.difficulty_reason: 41 行（含 16 行陈述）、交换映射合成相容性：精确陈述展开 + K-injective 代表元上两个方块映射均为拟同构（由交换引理之证明给出）+ K-injective-flat 引理使 Rg_* 落到 g_*，合成即外矩形的交换箭头。无 omit；作者对使用 K-injective-flat 快捷方式的 '(cheating)' 备注 为自嘲式说明非缺口。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2833-2848

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: spell out the statement: with the derived pushforwards of the composites written as the compositions, the outer rectangle's exchange map must equal the composite of the two square exchange maps; on K-injective representatives both square maps are quasi-isomorphisms by the proof of the exchange lemma, the K-injectivity of the pushed-forward complexes (which the author flags as an avoidable shortcut) makes the derived pushforward act as the plain pushforward, and the composition of the two represented maps is the rectangle's exchange arrow (source lines 2850-2890)
